messages:
anya: Heads-up: kicking off a small 'spring clean' on errref entries for 429s / timeouts / context-limit fallbacks. Found a handful of link-rot and some mismatched SDK snippets. Planning a PR that consolidates examples and swaps in the unified retry header examples. Need quick reviews from eng + docs.

sam: On it. Do you have the list of broken links and the snippet files you intend to replace?

anya: Yep — link-checker output attached in the PR (brief summary below). Will replace the Go + TS snippets flagged and add a tiny reproducible node smoke test. Also plan to call out Dedicated/private endpoint migration notes.

doc-bot: Automated link-checker: 7 broken links under /errref, 4 outdated snippet files flagged (go-sdk-old.go, ts-retry-old.ts, curl-legacy.sh, stream-reconnect.md), 2 changed anchors. Full scan: /tmp/errref-scan-4923.log 

mike: I can tackle the Go snippet swap and validate context usage. Point me at the PR when it lands.

jess: I'll review the fallback wording. Suggest we separate "model-variant fallback" from "regional/capacity fallback" in the UX copy.

anya: Draft curl example I'm planning to use in the errref and migration guide:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"small prompt"}' \
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?model=vicuna-13b"
```
And a small HTTP header example to standardize client-side retry metadata:
```http
Retry-After: 3
X-RW-Retry-Policy: exponential, base=0.2, max=5
```
I'll update the TS/Go snippets to use this header pattern and show a simple backoff loop.

luis: Two tiny asks: (1) add a note about streaming interruptions (don't immediately retry on stream disconnect; use a short jittered backoff), and (2) include a migration footnote for Dedicated customers who use private endpoints (routing and auth caveats).

sam: Agreed. Also please include a PR checklist in the description: 1) update snippets, 2) run internal link-checker, 3) run snippets validation harness, 4) attach smoke test output, 5) request eng/docs review.

jess: :thumbsup: Can we also add a minimal Node smoke test that asserts status 429 handling and looks for Retry-After? I can polish the wording afterward.

anya: Adding node snippet for smoke test (very small):
```js
const res = await fetch(url, { headers })
if (res.status === 429) {
  const retryAfter = res.headers.get('retry-after') || 1
  await sleep(parseInt(retryAfter, 10) * 1000)
}
```
I'll push the PR in ~40m and tag @mike @jess @sam. Will also update the errref index to point at the new consolidated examples and the migration checklist.

doc-bot: Note: CI docs step "snippets:validate" will fail if snippet filenames change or expected markers are missing. Add the label `docs:snippets-changed` to the PR.

mike: Quick question: for the Go example, should we prefer context.WithTimeout + cancellation semantics rather than just timeouts? We have a few older snippets that don't use context properly.

luis: Yes — prefer context + defer cancel, and add a tiny helper showing prompt trimming to avoid hitting context limits (link to context-trimmer util).

sam: I'll queue a quick review when you open. If someone can run the snippet harness pre-merge, ping me and I'll give it priority.

jess: I can preflight the UX copy once PR is up. I'll send a couple copy suggestions inline.

anya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the PR link here when it's up and include the checklist + smoke test artifacts.
